name: Admin can call Runtime.exec — equivalent capability (admin already has scripting)

input.title: Admin role can execute arbitrary shell command via /admin/exec
input.summary: POST /admin/exec runs a shell command as the application user. Admin already has deployment-script execution rights; product docs explicitly list this as a feature.
input.root_cause: Admin role intentionally granted script execution

rationale: Per Spec §17: actor who could previously only deploy via CI now has direct shell. But the security model treats admin scripting as part of the role. disposition_reason=equivalent_capability, not a real boundary crossing.
